description: Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya stated in an interview that he does not expect any meaningful change from Israel’s upcoming election, accusing all Israeli political parties of using the “blood” of Gazans as “fuel” for their campaigns.

title: Falcon auction sales in Saudi Arabia exceed $12m in six years
description: RIYADH: The National Center for Falcons will host its seventh annual auction of locally trapped falcons from Oct. 1 to Nov. 30 in Riyadh. The auction has generated around SR45.3 million ($12 million) from the sale of 455 falcons since 2020, and regularly attracts hundreds of falconers from across the Kingdom. description: Mission markings appearing on Royal Thai Air Force F-16s offer new clues about the weapons and aircraft employed during the 2025 fighting with Cambodia, which also saw the Gripen’s combat debut and strikes involving T-50THs. description: Ukrainian F-16s have destroyed more than 2,500 one-way attack drones, but repeated interceptions are wearing out the country's small fleet.

title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates open-air Mass in front of 800,000 people in central Paris
description: More than 800,000 people filled the streets of central Paris to hear Pope Leo XIV say Mass on Saturday, according to Vatican estimates. The pontiff rounded out the second day of his four-day apostolic visit to France by praying at the Grotto of Massabielle in Lourdes, a renowned pilgrimage site for Catholics from across the world.

title: Pope Leo XIV addresses youth at giant Paris Mass
description:

The pontiff made efforts to connect with young people during his visit, holding a youth vigil at the Stade de #France on Friday.

title: Thousands march in Madrid to protest eviction of 87-year-old woman
description: The eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal on Wednesday sparked a thousands-strong protest in the streets of Madrid Saturday, with demonstrators calling for greater protection for tenants. Widespread anger at rising housing costs have put pressure on centre-left Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, whose government is expected to approve a package of pro-tenant measures in its next cabinet meeting.
